-// TestMain adds package-scoped goleak ignores for HTTP transport goroutines
-// that survive kube-apiserver teardown. The CRD conversion webhook client
-// cache (apiextensions-apiserver's CRConverterFactory → webhook.ClientManager)
-// holds strong references to *rest.RESTClient — and therefore to
-// *http.Transport — past server.TearDownFn. Client-go's tlsTransportCache
-// uses weak references (ClientsAllowTLSCacheGC=beta), but the strong ref from
-// the converter factory prevents finalization within a typical test deadline,
-// leaving idle persistConn.{readLoop,writeLoop} goroutines that
-// framework.goleakFindRetry then polls up to 600 s for.
 func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
-	framework.EtcdMain(m.Run,
-		goleak.IgnoreTopFunction("net/http.(*persistConn).readLoop"),
-		goleak.IgnoreTopFunction("net/http.(*persistConn).writeLoop"),
-	)
+	framework.EtcdMain(m.Run)
 }

index b51fffb4bee..1c0f6699433 100644
--- a/test/integration/framework/etcd.go
+++ b/test/integration/framework/etcd.go
@@ -251,12 +251,8 @@ func RunCustomEtcd(logger klog.Logger, dataDir string, customFlags []string) (ur
 	return customURL, stop, nil
 }
 
-// EtcdMain starts an etcd instance before running tests. Callers can pass
-// additional goleak options (e.g. IgnoreTopFunction filters) that will be
-// appended to the ignore list used by the post-test goroutine leak check.
-// This lets a specific test package suppress leaks it knowingly triggers
-// without every other package inheriting the ignore.
-func EtcdMain(tests func() int, extraGoleakOpts ...goleak.Option) {
+// EtcdMain starts an etcd instance before running tests.
+func EtcdMain(tests func() int) {
 	// Bail out early when -help was given as parameter.
 	flag.Parse()
 
@@ -284,7 +280,6 @@ func EtcdMain(tests func() int, extraGoleakOpts ...goleak.Option) {
 		// Ignore this reported leak.
 		goleak.IgnoreTopFunction("github.com/moby/spdystream.(*Connection).shutdown"),
 	)
-	goleakOpts = append(goleakOpts, extraGoleakOpts...)
 
 	stop, err := startEtcd(klog.Background(), false)
 	if err != nil {

diff --git a/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/authorizer/conditionsenforcer/conditionsenforcer.go b/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/authorizer/conditionsenforcer/conditionsenforcer.go

+++ b/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/authorizer/conditionsenforcer/conditionsenforcer.go
@@ -109,16 +109,7 @@ func (c *conditionsEnforcer) Validate(ctx context.Context, a admission.Attribute
 	}
 
 	// Call the original authorizer back with the admission data
-	decision, reason, err := authz.EvaluateConditions(ctx, possiblyConditionalDecision, versionedAttributes)
-
-	// Enforce the evaluated decision to only evaluate to something that is beforehand possible
-	if !possiblyConditionalDecision.PossibleDecisions().Has(decision) {
-		// err uses the decision before overwriting it
-		err = fmt.Errorf("authorizer tried to return %s from EvaluateConditions, but the possible outcomes were %v", decision.String(), sets.List(possiblyConditionalDecision.PossibleDecisions()))
-
-		decision = possiblyConditionalDecision.FailureDecision()
-		reason = "failed closed"
-	}
+	decision, reason, err := evaluateWithReturnGuard(ctx, authz, possiblyConditionalDecision, versionedAttributes)
 
 	// The code flow here should exactly match filters.WithAuthorization.
 	// an authorizer could encounter evaluation errors and still allow the request, so authorizer decision is checked before error here.
@@ -149,3 +140,14 @@ func (c *conditionsEnforcer) Validate(ctx context.Context, a admission.Attribute
 
 	return responsewriters.ForbiddenStatusError(authzAttrs, reason)
 }
+
+// Evaluate the conditions, but enforce the evaluated decision to only evaluate to something that is beforehand possible
+func evaluateWithReturnGuard(ctx context.Context, authz authorizer.Authorizer, decisionToEvaluate authorizer.ConditionsAwareDecision, versionedAttributes *admission.VersionedAttributes) (authorizer.Decision, string, error) {
+	decision, reason, err := authz.EvaluateConditions(ctx, decisionToEvaluate, versionedAttributes)
+
+	if !decisionToEvaluate.PossibleDecisions().Has(decision) {
+		return authorizer.DecisionDeny, "failed closed", fmt.Errorf("authorizer tried to return %s from EvaluateConditions, but the possible outcomes were %v", decision.String(), sets.List(decisionToEvaluate.PossibleDecisions()))
+	}
+
+	return decision, reason, err
+}
